plan.title: Convert RFQ to Auction Without Carried Bids

steps.note: Open the existing concluded RFQ with quotations from the setup.
a template comes first on the create screen
a product is needed before participants or publishing

args.goal: On the conversion prompt and converted auction create screen, uncheck the carry-forward RFQ quotations checkbox, configure the auction, save the configuration, and publish the auction as requested; stop on the published auction page.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for the conversion checkbox or saving this configuration, so perform those actions on screen.
Assert that the converted auction was published successfully.
Open the auction comparison view to inspect whether any RFQ quotations were carried forward as starting bids.
Assert that the auction has no carried-forward bids before any fresh auction bid is submitted.
